# tritonctl storage

Object storage: buckets, storage users, access keys

Subcommands: buckets, users, access-keys

Usage: `tritonctl storage [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`

## tritonctl storage buckets

List buckets, with object counts and sizes

Usage: `tritonctl storage buckets [OPTIONS]`

## tritonctl storage users

List storage users, which own access keys

Usage: `tritonctl storage users [OPTIONS]`

## tritonctl storage access-keys

List a storage user's access keys. No secret material

Usage: `tritonctl storage access-keys [OPTIONS] --user <USER>`

- `--user <USER>` (required)
